source.text:
//@version=4
strategy(title="W9_Q_S1B_V4_SHAPE_B", overlay=false, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=0.00003, default_qty_value=20000, initial_capital=1000)

// W9-T3b, GENERATED by tools/vendor_harness/w9_probes.py: do not edit by hand (`--check` fails on a diff).
// Row Q-S1b on NYSE:RDDT 1D. Settles: the v4 margin default (Margin Long / Short read back) for the declaration shape title, overlay, commission_type, commission_value, default_qty_value, initial_capital (ruling D12b)
// Capture with tools/vendor_harness/tv_capture.js (gradeMethod set; settings read back). Never the CSV, never exportData().

fast = sma(close, 5)
slow = sma(close, 20)
up = crossover(fast, slow)
dn = crossunder(fast, slow)
if up
    strategy.entry("L1", strategy.long)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and bar_index % 4 == 0
    strategy.entry("L2", strategy.long)
if dn
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)

plot(strategy.initial_capital, title="X01_initial_capital")

// ── standard set (5.1), appended by tools/vendor_harness/w9_probes.py ──
plot(time, title="S01_time_CONTROL")
plot(bar_index, title="S02_bar_index_CONTROL")
plot(strategy.position_size, title="S03_position_size")
plot(strategy.position_avg_price, title="S04_position_avg_price")
plot(strategy.opentrades, title="S05_opentrades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, title="S06_closedtrades")
plot(strategy.netprofit, title="S07_netprofit")
plot(strategy.equity, title="S08_equity")
plot(strategy.openprofit, title="S09_openprofit")
// Pine v4 has no strategy.closedtrades.*(i) functions and no per-close label: the trade list is not rebuilt here
